metadata.title: Retech Solutions | Vietnam Software Development & IT Outsourcing
metadata.description: Retech Solutions is a Vietnam-based software development firm building custom CMS, CRM, ERP and AI-powered products for teams worldwide. Talk directly with the engineers who would build it.

services.cmsDesc: Headless and traditional CMS with AI tagging, smart search, and editorial copilots
services.crmDesc: CRMs with AI lead scoring, conversation intelligence, and predictive workflows
services.erpDesc: ERPs with AI forecasting, anomaly detection, and automated reporting
services.webDesc: Web apps with optional LLM features, vector search, and AI-assisted ops baked in
services.uiuxDesc: Product design for AI-native interfaces, including copilot UX and conversational flows
services.teamsDesc: Embedded engineers experienced in shipping RAG, agents, and LLM integrations
services.mobileDesc: iOS and Android apps from a shared codebase, from booking flows to field tools
services.desktopDesc: Windows and macOS software for work that outgrows the browser tab
services.aiDesc: RAG, assistants, and document intelligence where the use case justifies them
services.consultingDesc: Architecture reviews, due diligence, and roadmaps before you commit

footer.positioningSub: We design and build software that brings clarity to complex business workflows.

hero.standfirst: Full-cycle software development: business analysis, design, and deployment, with custom CRM and business systems at the core.

finalCta.body: Tell us what you need to build. You get a scoped project plan with a detailed written estimate, and a delivery process you can inspect from the first sprint.

capabilities.label: Capabilities
capabilities.h2: Custom CRM and business systems come first, because that is where most operations break.
capabilities.lede: Around that core: web, mobile, and desktop engineering, applied AI, and IT consulting.

featured.title: Custom CRM and business systems
featured.what: CRMs and internal systems shaped around your workflow: roles and permissions, pipelines, integrations with the tools you already run, and migration from spreadsheets or legacy software.
featured.fits: Fits operators whose off-the-shelf CRM forces their process into someone else's template.

scope.label: Workflow fit
scope.text: Modeled on how your team actually operates.

scope.label: Migration
scope.text: From spreadsheets or a legacy system.

rows.title: Web applications
rows.what: Customer-facing portals and internal platforms built on Next.js with typed APIs.
rows.fits: Fits teams that need a dependable web product their customers use daily.

rows.title: Mobile apps
rows.what: iOS and Android applications from a shared codebase, from booking flows to field tools.
rows.fits: Fits products where the customer is on a phone, not at a desk.

rows.title: Desktop applications
rows.what: Desktop software for Windows and macOS when the work needs more than a browser tab.
rows.fits: Fits operations with local hardware, large files, or offline work.

rows.title: Applied AI
rows.what: AI features added where the use case justifies them: document intelligence, assistants, analysis pipelines.
rows.fits: Fits teams with real data and a measurable task, not a demo.

rows.title: IT consulting
rows.what: Architecture reviews, technical due diligence, and roadmap planning before you commit to a build.
rows.fits: Fits leaders who need an independent read before spending.

discovery.label: Discovery
discovery.title: We start with how your business works
discovery.body: Every engagement begins with a map of your workflows, data, and constraints. The systems we design follow from that picture.

concepts.label: Concepts
concepts.lede: Explore thoughtfully designed software experiences built around real business workflows.
concepts.delivered: Delivered work — browse all case studies

work.label: Selected work
work.h2: Five systems, five operators, one standard of delivery.
work.lede: Each case study names the problem, our scope and responsibility, the solution, and the outcome.
work.coversNote: The covers in this section are contextual photography, not product captures; each case-study page captions its own product imagery.

delivery.label: Delivery and quality
delivery.h2: A delivery process you can inspect at every step.
delivery.lede: No fixed-duration promises. The phases are fixed; the clock depends on scope.

steps.title: Discover
steps.what: We map your workflow, roles, systems, and constraints with the people who use them.
steps.sees: a written scope and architecture proposal.

steps.title: Design
steps.what: Screens, data models, and integration plans are agreed before implementation starts.
steps.sees: clickable flows and a technical design.

steps.title: Build
steps.what: The system ships in reviewed increments you can open and test, and each phase closes against agreed acceptance criteria with your team testing hands-on.
steps.sees: a working build each cycle and a signed acceptance per phase.

steps.title: Release
steps.what: Staged rollout with data migration, monitoring, and your team trained on the real system. Documentation, access, and source code are yours; ongoing engineering is optional, not a lock-in.
steps.sees: production live, with runbooks and a complete handover package.

ai.label: Our approach to AI
ai.h2: Two separate questions: how we build, and what goes in your product.

blocks.title: How we build with AI
blocks.body: Our engineers use AI tooling to accelerate implementation. Every line that ships is reviewed and owned by an engineer whose name is on the delivery.
blocks.note: AI assists the build. It does not replace accountability.

blocks.title: AI inside your product
blocks.body: We add AI features when the use case justifies them: the task is measurable, your data is ready, and the operating cost is understood before anyone writes a prompt.
blocks.note: No AI for its own sake. Some products are better without it.

engagement.label: Engagement and cost
engagement.h2: Three ways to work with us. Costs quoted per scope, never guessed.

rows.title: Discovery
rows.body: A scoped engagement that maps requirements, architecture, and a delivery plan before you commit to a build.

rows.title: Scoped project
rows.body: A fixed-scope build with defined phases, acceptance criteria, and a delivery timeline you can hold us to.

rows.title: Ongoing engineering
rows.body: A dedicated team shipping increments against a prioritized backlog, month after month.

engagement.drivers: Scope, the number of platforms, integrations with existing systems, roles and permissions complexity, and third-party costs (infrastructure, licenses, model APIs). We quote against these factors after discovery, so the number reflects your system rather than a rate card.
engagement.ctaLine: Not sure which shape fits? Start with a scoped discovery.
